decisions.reason: Because submarine interior lighting is relatively distant from the firm's core lighting knowledge and was only lightly represented on the website, management would see weaker absorptive capacity and a higher chance of redeploying resources elsewhere.

A medical examination light builds on the firm's existing lighting expertise and in-house R&D, so early market learning should be interpretable and the product should be improvable within the firm's knowledge base.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit closely with the firm's professional industrial offering, certified manufacturing and engineering capabilities, making this a strong absorptive-capacity case for continued support.

The designer task light is close to the established offer and was presented as a relaunch of a popular product, suggesting the firm already has relevant knowledge and market feedback to justify keeping it.
